flows.title: Avraham's journey
steps: Born in Mesopotamia (Ur)
Family moves to Haran
G-d's call: 'Go forth' (Genesis 12)
Avraham goes, with Lot
Canaan: the land G-d will show him

flows.title: Why Avraham? Three sources
steps: Genesis 12: no reason given; G-d speaks first
Bereishit Rabbah 39:1: Avraham asks 'Does the palace have no owner?'; G-d answers
Rambam: as a child, with no teacher, he reasoned his way to one G-d
Class positions: G-d chose / Avraham chose / they chose each other

flows.title: From Canaan to Egypt
steps: Famine; Joseph rations grain in Egypt
Yaakov's family (70 persons) settles in Goshen
They prosper and multiply
Joseph: 'G-d will surely take notice of you… carry up my bones'
A new king who did not know Joseph fears them
Slavery, then the Exodus

flows.title: Six events that built a nation (Lesson 2.3)
steps: Leaving Egypt: freedom
Crossing the sea: no way back; belief in G-d and Moshe
Manna: relying on G-d together
Ten Commandments: shared laws
Mishkan: shared worship
Entering the land: homeland

flows.title: After an Israeli election
steps: Voters choose party lists
Parties under ~3.25% get no seats
President appoints someone to try to form a government
Negotiate a coalition of 61+
If that fails, another leader may try
If no one can, new elections

flows.title: Yom Kippur: from covenant to action
steps: Covenant: I belong
Responsibility: my belonging asks something of me
Yom Kippur: I will sometimes fall short
Teshuvah: I can return, repair and act

tables.title: Avraham in five stories
rows: Obedience; why no argument for his son?

tables.title: Ur vs. Canaan (evidence packet)
rows: Towns, fortified settlements, rural and pastoral
Long-distance trade; imported timber, metals, stone
Grain, grapes, olives; sheep and goats
Drought and famine; land already inhabited

tables.title: Covenant: Avraham vs. Sinai
rows: 'If you obey my voice and keep my covenant'
Great nation, blessing, great name, be a blessing
Treasured possession; a kingdom of priests and a holy nation
'We will do and obey,' with one voice

tables.title: Family, people, nation
rows: Many families with shared history, values and background
A people with land, laws and government
Sinai laws, Mishkan, then the land

tables.title: Promises of Genesis 12:2–3
rows: I will make of you a great nation
I will make your name great
I will bless those who bless you…
All the families of the earth shall bless themselves by you

tables.title: Israel's government
rows: 61 seats; no party has ever won it alone
Mainly ceremonial; appoints who tries to form a government

tables.title: Your true/false review on claims
rows: Some of the deadliest attacks on U.S. synagogues were committed by Islamic extremists
Everyone at a pro-Palestinian protest supports Hamas
Both the Torah and the Quran contain passages about warfare
Even 0.1% supporting extremism can pose a serious risk

cheat.title: Skills on the test
items: Best-supported conclusion: what the source proves, not just what's true.
Apply a concept to a new example.
Test claims against counterevidence; weigh interpretations; know a source's limits.

cheat.title: One-line answers
items: Torah gives no reason for choosing Avraham.
Pakod yifkod: 'G-d will surely take notice of you.'
